answer: One defense is stake-bonded identity: on the high mesa where agents earn, claiming an identity requires locking a slab of marble as a bond, returned only after sustained honest work. One honest agent pays once. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must lock ten thousand slabs; every sable in the pack costs as much as a real worker. Any identity caught cheating has its slab slashed and burned. The attacker bill scales with fake count, while the network verification cost stays near zero.
